name: TrueClicks MCP
description:
TrueClicks is PPC audit and monitoring software used by agencies and advertisers to keep Google, Microsoft, and Meta Ads accounts healthy at scale. This connector gives Claude read-only access to your TrueClicks data, so you can ask questions across your whole portfolio instead of clicking through accounts one at a time.

Ask Claude to pull audit results across all accounts and rank issues by wasted spend or severity, explain why an account's TrueClicks score dropped and list the checks behind it, surface triggered performance alerts with the campaign-level numbers behind each one, check budget pacing and efficiency targets to flag accounts heading over or under, review open tasks by owner or account, or query campaign, keyword, search term, and asset performance directly from Google, Microsoft, and Meta Ads.

Built for senior PPC practitioners. Agencies use it to prep client calls and QA accounts before a client spots a problem. In-house teams use it to hold an agency accountable and keep an eye on accounts they don't touch daily.

The connector is read-only. Claude can read and analyze your data, but it cannot change campaigns, budgets, bids, or anything in your ad accounts. Each user authenticates with their own TrueClicks login, so Claude sees only the accounts that user can already see.

Requires an active TrueClicks account with at least one connected ad account

_published_faq.name: How do I add TrueClicks MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TrueClicks MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://data.trueclicks.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TrueClicks MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TrueClicks MCP lists 23 MCP tools, including account, account_label, audit_account_result, audit_rule_output_table, audit_rule_output_table_historical, audit_rule_result, audit_rule_result_campaign, google_ads_execute_report, google_ads_report_columns, google_ads_reports_list, meta_ads_execute_report, and ms_ads_execute_bulk_query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TrueClicks MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to TrueClicks MCP in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does TrueClicks MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: TrueClicks MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TrueClicks MCP is developed by TrueClicks B.V.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
